slots.title: Bitcoin ETFs attract $1.08 billion in 3 days but it may not be enough for a steep rally
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Past steep rallies ran on about $235 million a day of net inflows into ETFs. The funds are yet to match that pace, according to data analyzed by CoinDesk.
